categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the tank container industry, focusing on the design, R&D, manufacturing, and sales of liquid and liquefied gas (ambient temperature) containerized logistics equipment. It also has a medical equipment components segment producing parts for high-end medical imaging devices, especially MRI equipment. Additionally, the company provides aftermarket services including cleaning, maintenance, inspection, and storage for tank containers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including modular design, automated production, and lean logistics. It emphasizes intelligent upgrades integrating IoT and sensor technologies for real-time monitoring and safety warnings. The firm has developed proprietary technologies such as intelligent sensing, virtual simulation design, cold and heat chain storage equipment, special medium storage, lightweight structural design, automated welding, and precision manufacturing for medical equipment components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international tank container leasing companies, operators, and chemical enterprises, as well as leading medical MRI equipment manufacturers. The company serves industries such as chemical logistics, food, new energy, and high-purity semiconductors. Its products are used globally by major chemical companies like BASF, DuPont, Wanhua Chemical, Solvay, CATL, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces, and has overseas subsidiaries in the Netherlands, the UK, and Hong Kong. Its sales and services cover major global markets including Asia (excluding mainland China), North America, Europe, Oceania, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and service provider of tank containers and related equipment. It sources raw materials such as steel and valves from upstream suppliers and sells finished products and services downstream to leasing companies, operators, and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include lean innovation, intelligent transformation, global tank container penetration, and green development. R&D focuses on safety, lightweight design, intelligent monitoring systems, new energy logistics equipment, and medical imaging components. The company invests in smart manufacturing, digital upgrades, and expanding product lines into high-value special containers and intelligent equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of tank containers and medical equipment components. The company also earns income from aftermarket services such as cleaning, repair, inspection, and storage. Sales are conducted via a direct sales model targeting leasing companies, operators, chemical firms, and medical device manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in tank container manufacturing, holding approximately 50% market share worldwide. Major competitors include Sifang Technology, Welfit Oddy (South Africa), Shengshi Container, Jingjiang Yatai, and Dalian CRRC. The company is recognized as a manufacturing champion in China and maintains a strong competitive position through technology leadership and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.35 billion, a 28.18% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 303.87 million, down 49.01%. The decline was mainly due to reduced demand in the tank container market. The company’s total assets were about RMB 5.45 billion with a stable R&D investment ratio of around 3.7%. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains a solid financial base and continues investing in growth projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a full range of tank containers with high safety, efficiency, and environmental standards, supporting multi-modal transport and specialized logistics needs. Its products feature advanced intelligent monitoring and safety systems, lightweight designs, and compliance with international certifications. The company provides one-stop lifecycle services including aftermarket support, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational reliability. Its medical equipment components are recognized for precision and quality, establishing strategic partnerships with industry leaders.
